description: This file defines the Language class within the OpenCart system, responsible for loading, managing, and retrieving localization (language) strings in the application.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class that manages language strings, supporting loading from files, retrieving, setting, clearing, and prefix-based filtering of language data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language object with a language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path associated with a namespace for finding language files.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a language string by key; returns the key itself if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a given key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all language data from the object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from a file, supports caching, and can prefix keys.
